attributes.description:
Render a disclosure button above the accessible data table so a sighted reader can reveal the numbers behind the chart on demand. `withDataTable` alone is all-or-nothing -- the table is either permanently screen-reader-only or permanentl…

Controls which cartesian grid axes are drawn.

Accessible chart label.

Default: `'auto'`

`datum` renders category toggles for pie/doughnut/polar-area charts.

attributes.name: min

Minimum value-axis bound.

Default: `null`

Default: `[]`

attributes.name: scale-type

Scale type for the **value** axis (the categorical axis is unaffected). `'logarithmic'` plots a dataset spanning several orders of magnitude honestly, where a linear axis collapses everything below the maximum into the baseline.

Default: `'linear'`

Type: `LyraSize`  
Default: `'m'`

attributes.name: stack-totals

Default: `false`

attributes.name: stacked

Default: `false`

attributes.name: sync-group

Synchronizes the visible active category with categorical vertical bar/line charts in the same owner document.

Type: `string`  
Default: `''`

attributes.name: type

Chart.js chart type (`bar` by default); an unrecognized attribute value falls back to `bar`.

Type: `LyraChartType`  
Default: `'doughnut'`

attributes.name: with-data-table

Makes the generated data table visible; it remains screen-reader available when false.

Default: `false`

attributes.name: without-animation

Disables Chart.js animation.

Default: `false`

attributes.name: without-legend

Hides the legend.

Default: `false`

attributes.name: without-tooltip
attributes.description:
Hides Chart.js tooltips.

Default: `false`

[Documentation](https://github.com/aceshooting/lyra-ui/blob/main/packages/lyra-ui/llms/components/lr-drop-zone.md)

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description:
Native-`accept`-style allowlist (`".csv,.xlsx"`, `"image/*"`, comma-separated mixes) -- identical parsing to `lr-file-input`'s `accept`, via the same `matchesAccept()`.

Type: `string`  
Default: `''`

attributes.name: accepted-message
attributes.description:
Message announced after an accepted drop; `{count}` becomes the accepted-file count. `undefined` uses the localized default; any supplied string, including `''`, is caller-owned.

Type: `string | undefined`

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description:
Disables drag/drop handling entirely; the wrapped content keeps its own interactivity.

Type: `boolean`  
Default: `false`

attributes.name: for
attributes.description:
Id of an existing element, in this zone's own root, to attach to instead of the default slot: the zone handles drags over that element and lays its overlay over it, so a server-rendered region becomes a drop target without being wrapped.

Type: `string`  
Default: `''`

attributes.name: held-file-count
attributes.description:
Externally held file count added to the running count `maxFiles` evaluates against -- identical contract to `lr-file-input`'s `heldFileCount`, letting a cumulative, server-backed cap span separate drops onto this region. `0` (the default…

Type: `number`  
Default: `0`

attributes.name: held-total-size
attributes.description:
Externally held byte total added to the running size `maxTotalSize` evaluates against -- identical contract to `lr-file-input`'s `heldTotalSize`.

Type: `number`  
Default: `0`

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description:
Optional locale override.

Type: `string`  
Default: `''`

attributes.name: max-file-size
attributes.description:
Largest accepted file size in bytes. `0` (the default) disables the check -- identical contract to `lr-file-input`'s `maxFileSize`, including its invalid-override fallback.

Type: `number`  
Default: `0`

attributes.name: max-files
attributes.description:
Largest number of files accepted per drop, counting `heldFileCount` plus the current drop's files. `0` (the default) disables the check -- identical contract to `lr-file-input`'s `maxFiles`.

Type: `number`  
Default: `0`

attributes.name: max-total-size
attributes.description:
Largest combined byte size accepted per drop, summing `heldTotalSize` plus the current drop's files. `0` (the default) disables the check -- identical contract to `lr-file-input`'s `maxTotalSize`.

Type: `number`  
Default: `0`

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description:
Accepts more than one file per drop, and enables recursive folder-drop traversal -- same contract as `lr-file-input`'s `multiple`.

Type: `boolean`  
Default: `false`

attributes.name: rejected-message
attributes.description:
Message announced after rejected files; `{count}` becomes the rejected-file count. `undefined` uses the localized default; any supplied string, including `''`, is caller-owned.

Type: `string | undefined`

attributes.name: size
attributes.description:
Density tier for the overlay's padding, icon and instructional text -- identical contract and scale to `lr-file-input`'s own `size`, so a small-tier drop-zone can match a neighboring small-tier `lr-file-input` in the same dense layout.

Type: `LyraSize`  
Default: `'m'`

attributes.name: without-rejection-list
attributes.description:
Omits the visible `[part="rejection"]` list for an application that renders its own banner from the `lr-files` detail.

Type: `boolean`  
Default: `false`

properties.name: --lr-positioning-strategy
properties.description:
**`<lr-app-rail-item>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the icon-only flyout tooltip's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-citation-badge>`, `<lr-entity-chip>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the preview popover's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-color-picker>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, read from computed style when the panel is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-combobox>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}, read from computed style when the listbox is positioned.

**`<lr-date-input>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the calendar popup's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-dropdown>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, inherited from the popover surface.

**`<lr-export-button>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the format menu's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-locale-picker>`, `<lr-mention-popover>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the listbox's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-menu>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the private submenu surface's `fixed` default, read from computed style when a submenu is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-model-select>`, `<lr-voice-picker>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the listbox; the default is `fixed` when no recognized ancestor value is set.

**`<lr-navigation-menu>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override read by the items when their panels are positioned.

**`<lr-navigation-menu-item>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override read when the panel is positioned.

**`<lr-popover>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}, read from computed style when the popup is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-select>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, read from computed style when the listbox is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-time-input>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the column picker's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-tool-call-chip>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the detail tooltip's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-tooltip>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for {@link positioningStrategy}/`hoist`, read from computed style when the bubble is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-tour>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the step popover's `fixed` default, read from computed style when a step is (re)positioned.

**`<lr-usage-badge>`** — Cascading `absolute`/`fixed` override for the breakdown tooltip's `fixed` default, read from computed style when it is (re)positioned.

properties.name: --lr-theme-scrollbar-color
properties.description:
**`<lr-code-block>`, `<lr-code-block-core>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by `body`; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-code-editor>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by the `editor` scroll frame; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-combobox>`, `<lr-select>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by the scrolling `listbox`; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-emoji-picker>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by the `grid` scroll container; set on `:root` or any ancestor to retune every internal scroll container.

**`<lr-menu>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by the scrolling `list`; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-table>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by the `base` scroll container; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-time-input>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by the scrolling `column` lists; set on `:root` or any ancestor to retune every internal scroll container.

**`<lr-virtual-list>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level `scrollbar-color` (thumb then track) honored by `base` scroll viewport; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

properties.name: --lr-theme-scrollbar-gutter

**`<lr-code-editor>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the `editor` scroll frame; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-combobox>`, `<lr-select>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the scrolling `listbox`; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-menu>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the scrolling `list`; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-table>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the `base` scroll container; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

**`<lr-virtual-list>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar gutter honored by the `base` scroll viewport; see `--lr-theme-scrollbar-width`.

properties.name: --lr-theme-scrollbar-width

**`<lr-table>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar width honored by the `base` scroll container; unset, renders identically to before.

**`<lr-virtual-list>`** (default: `auto`) — Opt-in theme-level scrollbar width honored by the `base` scroll viewport; unset, renders identically to before.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface)`) — Fill of the outer card (`[part="base"]`) while `frame="card"`. `frame="plain"` still removes the fill entirely.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Outline color of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-offset
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `calc(-1 * var(--lr-focus-ring-offset))`) — Inward offset of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`, keeping the outline inside its own scrollport so it is not clipped at the edge.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-style
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `solid`) — Outline style of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-body-hover-outline-width
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-focus-ring-width)`) — Outline width of the mouse-hover preview on `[part="body"]`.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-border-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-border)`) — Colour of the outer card's border and of the header/body divider, which `frame="plain"` keeps.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-body-font-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-size-sm)`) — Font size of `[part="body"]` while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-body-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-s)`) — `[part="body"]` padding while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-header-font-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-size-sm)`) — Font size of `[part="header"]` while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-header-gap
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs)`) — Gap between the header toggle, label, and duration while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-compact-header-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-2xs) var(--lr-space-s)`) — `[part="header"]` padding while `size` is `s` or smaller.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-header-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** — Pressed background of the header.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-header-hover-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand-quiet)`) — Hover background of `[part="header"]`.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-max-block-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-16rem)`) — Cap on how tall the expanded reasoning transcript grows before `[part="body"]` scrolls internally.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-pending-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-brand)`) — Live pending-state color.

properties.name: --lr-thinking-panel-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-thinking-panel>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius)`) — Corner radius of the outer card. `frame="plain"` still squares the corners.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-warning-quiet)`) — Background of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `currentColor`) — Foreground of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `0`) — Padding of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-excerpt-highlight-radius
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-radius-xs)`) — Corner radius of `<mark>` descendants returned by `renderExcerpt`.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-header-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface)`) — Group header background; sticky headers stay opaque so scrolled rows never show through.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-header-padding
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-space-xs) var(--lr-space-s)`) — Group header padding.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `color-mix(in oklab, var(--lr-thread-list-group-toggle-hover-bg, var(--lr-color-surface-raised)), var(--lr-color-mix-partner) var(--lr-color-mix-active))`) — Group-toggle pressed background.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-thread-list-group-toggle-hover-color, var(--lr-color-text))`) — Group-toggle pressed foreground.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text-quiet)`) — Group label colour at rest (set on the header, inherited by the toggle).

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-font-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-size-1em)`) — Group label font size, set on the header so the toggle and its `sticky-groups` copy match.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-font-weight
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-font-weight-semibold)`) — Group-toggle font weight.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-hover-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-surface-raised)`) — Group-toggle hover background.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-color-text)`) — Group-toggle hover foreground.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-group-toggle-min-block-size
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-icon-button-size)`) — Group-toggle minimum block size.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-active-bg
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-icon-button-bg-active, color-mix(in oklab, var(--lr-thread-list-row-action-hover-bg, var(--lr-icon-button-bg-hover, var(--lr-color-surface-raised))), var(--lr-color-mix-partner) var(--lr-color-mix-active)))`) — Row-action pressed background.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-active-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-icon-button-color-active, var(--lr-thread-list-row-action-hover-color, var(--lr-icon-button-color-hover, var(--lr-color-text))))`) — Row-action pressed foreground.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-hover-bg

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-row-action-hover-color
properties.description: **`<lr-thread-list>`** (default: `var(--lr-icon-button-color-hover, var(--lr-color-text))`) — Row-action hover foreground.

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-clear-size

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-font-size

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-gap

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-hover-border-color

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-min-height

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-padding

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-padding-block

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-padding-inline

properties.name: --lr-thread-list-search-radius

properties.name: --lr-time-input-action-active-bg

properties.name: --track-height
properties.description:
**`<lr-progress-bar>`** (default: `var(--lr-progress-track-height)`) — Web Awesome-compatible track height.

**`<lr-slider>`** — Shoelace alias for track thickness.

properties.name: --track-size
properties.description: **`<lr-slider>`** — Web Awesome alias for track thickness.

properties.name: --track-width
properties.description:
**`<lr-progress-ring>`** (default: `var(--lr-progress-ring-track-width)`) — Upstream-compatible track width.

**`<lr-spinner>`** (default: `var(--lr-spinner-track-width)`) — Upstream-compatible track width.

**`<lr-tab-group>`** — Upstream track width.

properties.name: --transition-duration
properties.description: **`<lr-data-grid>`** (default: `var(--lr-duration-fast)`) — Interaction transition duration.

properties.name: --wag-angle
properties.description: **`<lr-icon>`** (default: `12deg`) — Peak wag angle.

properties.name: --width
properties.description:
**`<lr-dialog>`, `<lr-drawer>`** (default: `var(--lr-dialog-width,auto)`) — Mapped panel width alias.

**`<lr-divider>`** (default: `var(--lr-border-width-thin)`) — Separator thickness.

**`<lr-switch>`** (default: `var(--lr-switch-track-inline-size)`) — WA/Shoelace alias for the track's inline size.

**`<lr-toast>`** — Mapped alias for `--lr-toast-width`.
